description: Image updates for the compose stacks. Every image is pinned to version@digest; Renovate opens PRs, nothing deploys on merge. See README > Updates.
prBodyNotes: **Deploy after merging:** on kiwisvr01, `git pull` in `~/docker`, then `docker compose up -d` in each changed stack directory (see the file list above).
